versions.changelog:
Initial release of seo-images: image optimization analysis for SEO and performance.

- Audits images for alt text, file size, formats (WebP/AVIF), responsive techniques, lazy loading, CLS prevention, descriptive file names, and CDN usage.
- Provides actionable recommendations and a summary table of optimization issues (missing alt text, large files, wrong format, etc).
- Prioritized image optimization list with estimated savings.
- Integrates with DataForSEO to analyze image SERP competitiveness (if available).
- Supports image file optimization: conversion, compression, metadata injection.
